answer: Escrowed Operator Liability: each agent identity registers against a refundable deposit held by a neutral steward, and any successful sybil cluster costs the operator the full deposit plus a surge charge resetting them below the entry summit. Attacker cost: N identities times deposit plus repeated resets.
